ui_4261cc1e72bdcb33: Iinthelo zikhuphula iindleko zokungeniswa kwempahla, kodwana intengo yabathengi ithembele emajini, izinto ezikhona, ukutjhugululwa kwabathengisi kanye nokufunwa. Izinga eliphezulu lentengo akutlhogeki bona litjho ukunyuka kwamanani okuphezulu unomphela: ukunyuka kwamandla wemali qobe mnyaka kungathoma ukuthoma lokha ukunyuka kokuthoma nakuphuma ekumadaniseni.
